notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Wispweaver Angel and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
